title: Builders collect choices
summary: A builder collects choices before producing a result. It helps when creation has several optional parts.
introduction: A builder collects choices before producing a result. It helps when creation has several optional parts. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not use a large builder when one short function is clearer.
